programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Chan eil sgeul air Fuigheag an-duigh is tha Boban bochd a’ feuchainn ri lorg. Càite fon ghrèin a bheil e? There’s no sign of Fuigheag today and poor Boban is searching for him. Where on earth is he?

programme.title: Lon le Linda
programme.desc: Tha Linda NicLeòid a’ còcaireachd cuide ri a caraidean. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha Mairead Màiri agus Aneirin còmhla rithe agus iad ag ullachadh mìlseag rus le raosaran-dubha. Ach mus tòisich iad, feumaidh iad a bhith cinnteach gu bheil an stuth a tha a dhìth orra a-staigh. Mur a bheil, bidh iad a’ dèanamh liosta agus a’ dol dhan bhùth airson a h-uile càil fhaighinn. Bidh Linda agus a caraidean cuideachd a’ faighinn a-mach ciamar a thathar a’ dèanamh sùgh raosar-dubh. Tha iad an uairsin a’ tilleadh dhan chidsin airson a’ mhìlseag rus ullachadh mus suidh iad sìos aig a’ bhòrd ga ithe. Linda is joined by Margaret Mary and Aneirin to make blackcurrant rice pudding. Before they start cooking they have to ensure they have all the ingredients. If not, they make a list and go shopping. They also learn more about how blackcurrant juice is made and then return to the kitchen to make the rice pudding, before sitting down to tuck in.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha stoirm le dealanaich is tàirneanaich a’ toirt luchd-tadhail chun an eilein. Tha Àtaidh is Tilidh air leth measail air na caraidean ùra aca, ach chan eil Nìp ro chinnteach. A thunderstorm brings some visitors to the island. Abney and Teal love their new friends, but Neep is not so sure.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Bha stoirm mhòr san Achadh Fhiadhaich ’s a nis tha bùrach mòr ann. Tha glanadh mòr ri dhèanamh. Following a huge storm in Wild Meadow, there is now a big mess and a lot of clearing up to be done.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan finds a treasure map in a bottle on the beach. Could it really lead to finding the lost booty of dreaded pirate Abby Birdy? Tha Dan air mapa-ulaidh a lorg ann am botal air an tràigh. Saoil an toir seo 'ad gu bhith a' lorg ulaidh na pioraid oillteil, Labraidh Sona?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ leughadh Aon Oidhche Shneachdail. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Nick Butterworth, agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Màiri NicCumhais. Coinneach Rankin reads Aon Oidhche Shneachdail, written and illustrated by Nick Butterworth and translated into Gaelic by Mairi MacCuish.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha na Pluic a’ ceannach ‘Grodbitan’ airson toirt orra beagan eacarsaich a dhèanamh. Chan fhada gu tuig iad gu bheil rudeigin fada ceàrr air na h-innealan, oir cha ghabh an cuir dheth às dèidh dhaibh uile an cleachdadh. Tha na Pluic ann an staing is gun dòigh aca air stad a dh’eacarsaich. Investing in GritBits to get them moving, the Spuds discover the devices are faulty and cannot be switched off once attached to their wrists. The Spuds quickly find themselves unable to stop exercising.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Pòl a’ cuideachadh cailleach air a bheil Tilidh, is tha i a’ toirt isbean dha mar thaing. An e mac-meanmna Phòil a th’ ann, no a bheil rudeigin fortanach a’ tachairt le gach greim a ghabhas e dhen isbean? Dave helps a local old lady called Tanya, who rewards him by giving him a sausage to say thank you. Is Dave imagining it or does something lucky happen every time he takes a bite?

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Chan eil iad a' creidsinn anns a' Cheann a Tuath g’ eil na h-aithrisean aig Artair fìor. Tha fear air nochdadh airson àit’ a ghabhail. Chan eil Artair deònach Trolberg fhàgail. Dè nì e? In the Northern Colonies, they don’t believe that Artair’s reports are true. Someone has come to take his place. Artair isn’t willing to leave Trolberg. What will he do?

programme.title: Na Speuran
programme.desc: Thèid air turas suas dha na speuran cuide ris an Speuradair Zach! Air an turas fànais iongantach seo tha e ag innse dhuinn mu Theileasgop Sheumais Webb. Bidh e cuideachd a’ beachdachadh air a’ cheist mhòr 'a bheil sìon beò air planaidean eile?' Blast off into space with Astronaut Zach! In this amazing space voyage, he tells us about the James Webb Telescope and also debates the age-old question: 'Is there life on other planets?'

programme.title: Eilean Mo Ghaoil (From Lewis with Love)
programme.desc: A team of archaeologists investigate a crannog in a loch in Carloway and it’s business as usual for veteran garage owner Denis.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na h-ath cheumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Tha Hamish Hepburn à Drochaid Chàrr a’ tadhal air Joy san stiùidio agus tha Calum MacIlleathain air Taobh Sear Rois is e ag ionnsachadh mu sheilleanan-mil. Joy Dunlop guides us through the next steps to speak Gaelic. Learner Hamish Hepburn from Carrbridge chats to Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean indulges his sweet tooth as he learns about beekeeping in Easter Ross. Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Garradh Phadruig
programme.desc: With the cold winter over, Peter starts preparing the garden for the growing season. Tha an geamhradh fuar seachad is tha Pàdruig a’deasachadh a’ghàrraidh airson àm fàs.

programme.title: An Cogadh Fuar: Cold War Stories
programme.desc: Stories of how the Cold War impacted the lives of ordinary people. Sgeulachdan mu mar a thug an Cogadh Fuar buaidh air beatha dhaoine àbhaisteach.

programme.title: Samhradh air Sàl
programme.desc: Angus Mackay is joined by longtime friend and colleague Tormod Macleod from Carloway as they go to sea for a day’s fishing off the east coast of Lewis. Along the way they encounter sea eagles and enjoy an environment lit by the sunshine of a beautiful summer’s day. Along the way they ponder the importance of fishing on family ties. Tha Tormod MacLeòid à Càrlabhagh – deagh charaid agus co-obraiche Aonghas MhicAoidh – còmhla ris agus iad a’ dol gu muir airson latha iasgaich far costa an ear Leòdhais. Coinnichidh iad ri iolairean-mara agus a’ ghrian a’ deàrrsadh air latha samhraidh brèagha. Air an t-slighe, tha iad a’ meòrachadh air cho cudromach ’s a tha iasgach do cheanglaichean teaghlaich.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Anns a’ phrògram seo, tha Evelyn Coull NicLeòid a’ gabhail cuairt chun nan Eileanan a Deas, gu Uibhist, Barraigh agus Bhatarsaigh gus coinneachadh ri daoine, cuid aig a bheil ceanglaichean làidir agus cuid eile a bha a’ fuireach ann am bailtean a tha a-nis air fhalamhachadh. Evelyn Coull MacLeod takes a journey to the Southern Isles - to Uist, Barra and Vatersay, where she meets people who have strong connections to or have lived in villages that are now abandoned.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap based on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Fàilte gu Fraochy Bay , baile nach fhaic thu a h-uile là! Is iomadh annas a tha ri fhaicinn sa bhaile , agus sin gun ghuth air càil ach muinntir a bhaile fhèin. Is ann dubhach a tha cuisean anns an doimhneachd ach ann a' làmhan fear de mhuinntir a bhaile chan fhada gus am bi fior thogail inntinn ann. Welcome to the colourful and unusual world of Fraochy Bay, a miniature metropolis somewhere off the fringes of the map, populated by a cast of unusual characters. A submarine seeks help from the town's resident inventor. Can he make their spirits soar?

programme.desc: Quiz show presented by Victoria Coren in which knowledge will only take you so far, as patience and lateral thinking are also vital. In the second of the quarter-finals, three postgraduate students from Brasenose College, Oxford, pit their wits against a trio of Douglas Adams fans who call themselves the Hitchhikers, in honour of the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy. They compete to draw together the connections between elements which, at first glance, seem utterly random: P J Tracy, Nicci French, Ellery Queen and Grant Naylor.

programme.title: Dave Allen: The Immaculate Selection
programme.desc: An anthology of Dave Allen's finest, funniest and most irreverent material, compiled from his time at the BBC from 1971 to 1986.

programme.title: Dave Allen: God's Own Comedian
programme.desc: Told by family and friends, with rare unseen archive, this documentary reflects on the career of Dave Allen, relative of poet Katharine Tynan, and a natural performer who cut his teeth at Butlins. He became a TV star in Australia in his twenties, before returning home to dominate the schedules here in Britain with his unique blend of sketches and stories in a career that took in films, plays, documentaries and chat shows, alongside award-winning comedy series. Respected, admired and with unshakeable integrity, Dave Allen fought for what he wanted to say and how he wanted to say it. He was driven by simple honesty. It was this solitary and determined path that made his talents special and unusual and inspired a generation of comics that were to follow. For the first time, this rich and compelling career is celebrated on screen, giving a chance to reflect on his many achievements and on the private life that went alongside it. With contributions from Stephen Berkoff, Stephen Frears, and Dame Maggie Smith, among others.

programme.title: Dave Allen
programme.desc: Irish stand-up comedian Dave Allen entertains a studio audience with his unique wit, humour and satirical observations. First broadcast in 1990.

programme.title: The American Revolution
programme.desc: Washington’s Continental Army emerges from the harsh winter at Valley Forge to fight the British Army in the inconclusive Battle of Monmouth. But the alliance with France changes the war and moves it to other theatres, and armies advance into Indian country and the southern states. Together, the British Army and Navy capture Charleston. A film by Ken Burns, Sarah Botstein and David Schmidt.

programme.title: London: A Tale of Two Cities with Dan Cruickshank
programme.desc: Dan Cruickshank follows in the footsteps of John Stow and John Strype, two of London's greatest chroniclers, to explore one of the most dramatic centuries in the history of London. The 17th century saw London plunged into a series of devastating disasters. The Civil War, a murderous plague and the destruction that was the great fire should have seen the small medieval city all but destroyed. Yet somehow, London not only survived but emerged as one of the wealthiest and most influential cities in Europe. Using two remarkable surveys written at either end of this momentous century, Dan discovers how a unique combination of innovation, ambition and sheer spirit of enterprise saw Londoners thrive. His journey reveals the twists and turns of a century that laid the foundations of one of the most important cities on the planet.

programme.title: My Kind of Town
programme.desc: In this episode, Ian and Major head to Shotts in North Lanarkshire, a town that’s feeling a bit unloved and down on its luck. Since the closing of its iron foundry, there has been very little solid employment. However, Ian and Major find plenty of places to go and people to chat to, visiting the prison, an abandoned psychiatric hospital, and even doing some street dancing.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Nick and Derek get some bad news, putting plans for taking over the family farm into sharp focus in Dumfries and Galloway. They are losing 300 acres of leased grazing land to forestry, and with concerns over when dad Derek might retire, Nick sets out a timeline for his succession. On Papa Westray, new farmers Paul and Mel are in the midst of their first big lambing season. With the addition of new baby Oak, it’s a family affair. Ten-year-old Jakey does the morning rounds, checking for new lambs, and spots a ewe in trouble - Paul has to call on his farming neighbours for help. At Hillhead Farm near Glasgow, Ben and Matt Imrie are tackling the wedding and events site infrastructure. The race is on to make it a marketable venue ahead of the first event of the season in six weeks' time. Their dad, John, has another pre-op for his hip replacement, and he and Antoinette hope he receives the news he is desperately waiting for.

programme.title: Body on the Beach: What Happened to Annie?
programme.desc: Within hours of Annie Borjesson's body being found on a Scottish beach, her family are told it is suicide. However, they believe the evidence points to murder.

programme.title: Body on the Beach: What Happened to Annie?
programme.desc: Hazel pieces together the mysterious final hours before Annie was found dead. She hears an extraordinary theory that Annie’s death was a state-sponsored hit job.

programme.title: The Troops
programme.desc: Scots defend trenches in Estonia, while others scout enemy lines and protect HQ. In Catterick, chaos reigns in riot training, while ceremonial troops in Edinburgh fight for redemption.

programme.title: Jules and Greg's Wild Swim
programme.desc: A night swim with a bit of sparkle at Peebles’ first Harvest Wild Swim Festival, a sleep under the stars in a Romany caravan, and tubing down the River Nith.

programme.title: Growing Up Scottish
programme.desc: Some of Scotland’s comedians and entertainers take us on journey through friendships past, reminiscing on the bonding, the hanging out, the best friends, the sleepovers and the strange noises. Then they turn their attention to homes of the past, looking back at the flats, the crofts, the bathrooms and the toilets, as well as addressing the controversial inside-outside debate.

programme.title: Joe Swash: Forgotten Young Dads
programme.desc: Too often overlooked in research and marginalised in society, many young dads across the UK are quietly rewriting the rulebook on fatherhood. In this revealing documentary, Joe Swash, who became a first-time father in his mid-twenties, meets four young men navigating the challenges of parenting. From stigma and financial strain to isolation and emotional growth, this is the rarely seen lived experience of men in their teens and twenties entering into fatherhood. With his trademark warmth and honesty, Joe explores what it really means to be a young dad today, and why the conversation about positive male role models is needed now more than ever.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson subjects the Skoda Yeti to a remarkably thorough road test, while James May makes a rare visit to the test track in the insane Aerial Atom V8. Meanwhile, Richard Hammond celebrates the incredible evolution of the Porsche 911 by racing a modern Turbo Cabriolet against its oldest relative and the power of gravity. Plus there is more heated studio debate with the return of the Cool Wall, and another celebrity guest takes their turn in the Reasonably Priced Car.

programme.desc: Stacey and her gang - organiser Dilly, carpenter Rob and cleaner Iwan - challenge the Daniels family to sort their life out in seven days.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Wildlife expert Steve Backshall heads for the Australian continent as he continues his Deadly 60 mission. Perth is home to one of Australia's deadliest snakes, the tiger snake. A surprise is in store as these snakes live right alongside the visitors to the city's local park. With their unique way of catching their supper, pelicans prove to be worthy of a place on Steve's Deadly 60 list and a magical dive with bottlenose dolphins illustrates what incredible predators they are.

programme.title: Sort Your Life Out
programme.desc: The Smith family embark upon a mammoth declutter. Stacey and the team challenge them to let go of half of their possessions, so that they can beautifully reorganise their life and home.

programme.title: I Kissed a Girl
programme.desc: A surprise new arrival ruffles feathers in the masseria, exposing cracks in some relationships. As one couple wakes up feeling frosty, another hits a bump in the road. A note from Dannii sends one girl's head spinning, and a pair calls it quits before a surprise Kiss-Off. But, as one door closes, another opens, and the masseria’s balcony hosts a duo’s dramatic debut, which is set to rock the summer of love.

programme.title: I Kissed a Girl
programme.desc: After a climactic Kiss-Off, two new arrivals embark on their summer of love. But will the ghost of girlfriends past drive a wedge between one couple? An evening folly ends in tears, tough conversations and trust issues, while the Icons party offers some welcome light relief. And when northern queen Charley Marlowe ditches the voice-over booth for some ‘dolce vita’ with Dannii, an epic awards ceremony presents a heart-wrenching decision for two divas.

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: A young boy and his grandmother have a run-in with a coven of witches and their leader. Based on the Roald Dahl novel.

programme.title: Mood
programme.desc: Sasha goes to visit her family in their new home, and as everyone tries to paper over the cracks, it’s clear Sasha doesn’t belong. She returns to the studio with Kobi, but struggles as her old and new worlds collide, especially when Kobi reveals he knows about Sasha’s online identity. At Abi’s birthday party, someone from Sasha's past appears and forces her to run. As Sasha dives into her new work, she meets tech entrepreneur Kasper, who offers her a new perspective.

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: An exploration of the experiences of deaf people accessing healthcare across the UK, asking why communication barriers continue to affect patient care despite legal accessibility requirements. Presenter Ahmed Mudawi is joined by Lucy Warnes, chief executive of SignHealth. Together, they discuss the challenges deaf people face when accessing NHS services, the importance of the Accessible Information Standard and the ongoing campaign for equal access to healthcare.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Away from Hampshire's famous ports and bustling harbours lies a wild world of woodland, heathland and chalk streams. Matt Baker and Charlotte Smith meet the people working to find, protect and celebrate the county's lesser-spotted wildlife. Charlotte also investigates how proposed changes to visa rules could affect sheep shearing in the UK.

programme.title: Springwatch
programme.desc: As week 3 begins, it’s time to catch up with all the weekend wildlife drama. Chris Packham and Michaela Strachan share all the stories continuing to unfold on the nest cameras from National Trust Crom in Northern Ireland. Meanwhile, Iolo Williams has migrated north to Bempton Cliffs for a seabird extravaganza, featuring gannets, puffins, kittiwakes and guillemots.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: An epic six-year renovation journey of a former barn in Kent comes to a conclusion. Martin is perplexed by stairs leading up to a shower - of all things! And Dion is betwixt and between two areas in the West Midlands.

programme.title: Farm 999
programme.desc: In Northern Ireland, farmer Mark Mahon is in despair as 12 of his sheep become stranded on rocks in Strangford Lough, one of the most dangerous tidal waters in the UK. With the tide rising fast and strong currents closing in, the RNLI and coastguard launch their most challenging rescue operation to date. In North Wales, a wildlife photographer captures evidence of a badger sett under attack. Quick thinking sets off an RSPCA and police investigation that uncovers a serious case of wildlife crime. And in South Yorkshire, reporter Paul Colgan joins the police Quad Squad as they tackle illegal off-road riding and the growing damage it causes to rural communities.

programme.title: Lost and Found in the Lakes
programme.desc: A tale of two rings. The freedivers head to Crummock Water to try to find Andy’s lost wedding ring, which his wife had told him never to wear in the lake. And over at Penrith Castle, can a wedding ring lost almost a decade ago be found in time for a silver wedding anniversary next year?

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: Punk Chef returns for more Cafe Conversations, where he meets guests in an informal cafe setting over coffee, with stories, laughter and personality revelations that explore whether drink choices reflect who people really are. He's joined first by Jenny Sealey, artistic director of Graeae Theatre Company, who shares a warm, funny and deeply honest conversation about her life, career and lived experience of becoming deaf at the age of seven. Next up is Nathan Rollinson, luxury brand consultant and content creator, who brings a vibrant and energetic presence to the table. Nathan talks about his multiple roles across social media, photography, fashion and consultancy.

programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella Lawson shows how easy it is to bring the spirit of Italy into the kitchen and on to the plate - using ingredients available in any English supermarket. With her passion for Italy and Italian cooking - she lived and worked in Florence before starting a degree in modern languages - Nigella's mouthwatering dishes have their roots in tradition but take us into fresh territory, knowledge worn light of touch but full on taste. In this first show, Nigella introduces us to her love of Italian food through a spectacular yet simple Sicilian pasta with tomatoes, garlic and almonds. There's a midweek family feast of tagliata - a juicy steak cut into thin slices - served with crisp, fluffy Tuscan fries. Plus Nigella's 'eggs in purgatory' - a late night fiery dish inspired by her early party days in Florence.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre’s Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula visits Belfast, Maine. She meets a local clam-digger who is keeping up the tradition of digging for clams by hand and heads to a restaurant which specialises in New England’s famous clam chowder. Paula is a big fan of maple syrup, so it is a real treat to visit a maple syrup farm and museum. Her final stop in New England is for some delicious lobster rolls. In her outdoor kitchen on the Maine shoreline, Paula cooks coal-baked quahog clams with leek, apple and kelp butter and Scotch pancakes with blueberries and smoked maple syrup.

programme.desc: An exploration of the experiences of deaf people accessing healthcare across the UK, asking why communication barriers continue to affect patient care despite legal accessibility requirements. programme.desc: In Northern Ireland, farmer Mark Mahon is in despair as 12 of his sheep become stranded on rocks in Strangford Lough, one of the most dangerous tidal waters in the UK. programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: Punk Chef returns for more Cafe Conversations, where he meets guests in an informal cafe setting over coffee, with stories, laughter and personality revelations that explore whether drink choices reflect who people really are. programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella Lawson shows how easy it is to bring the spirit of Italy into the kitchen and on to the plate - using ingredients available in any English supermarket. With her passion for Italy and Italian cooking - she lived and worked in Florence before starting a degree in modern languages - Nigella's mouthwatering dishes have their roots in tradition but take us into fresh territory, knowledge worn light of touch but full on taste. In this first show, Nigella introduces us to her love of Italian food through a spectacular yet simple Sicilian pasta with tomatoes, garlic and almonds. There's a midweek family feast of tagliata - a juicy steak cut into thin slices - served with crisp, fluffy Tuscan fries. Plus Nigella's 'eggs in purgatory' - a late night fiery dish inspired by her early party days in Florence.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre’s Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula visits Belfast, Maine. She meets a local clam-digger who is keeping up the tradition of digging for clams by hand and heads to a restaurant which specialises in New England’s famous clam chowder. Paula is a big fan of maple syrup, so it is a real treat to visit a maple syrup farm and museum. Her final stop in New England is for some delicious lobster rolls. In her outdoor kitchen on the Maine shoreline, Paula cooks coal-baked quahog clams with leek, apple and kelp butter and Scotch pancakes with blueberries and smoked maple syrup.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: When Christopher's posh old schoolmates arrive for the National Debating Championships final, the Scouse lads fear losing him to his old world. Instead, the groups begin to bond until a drunken factory break-in, crashed forklift and night in the cells forces Christopher to confront where he belongs. In the debate final, Christopher delivers a personal argument about why people divide themselves and how belonging to two worlds can be a strength. Meanwhile, Anna's return fractures Aimee and Wayne's alliance when she offers a different version of the past, leaving Aimee torn between loyalty to her dad and the mum she never stopped missing. Lewis's redemption arc implodes when his public apology tour exposes more chaos than growth, forcing Kieron to stage an intervention.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: Tom Allen celebrates funny cock-ups featuring our favourite TV shows and stars, with unseen outtakes and live broadcast bloopers from our favourite dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. Starring Idris Elba, Paul Rudd, Alan Carr, Gemma Collins, Ant and Dec, Susanna Reid, Helen Skelton, the cast of Coronation Street and many more, the cock-ups include Love Island filming being sabotaged by angry geese.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: When Christopher's posh old schoolmates arrive for the National Debating Championships final, the Scouse lads fear losing him to his old world. Instead, the groups begin to bond until a drunken factory break-in, crashed forklift and night in the cells forces Christopher to confront where he belongs. In the debate final, Christopher delivers a personal argument about why people divide themselves and how belonging to two worlds can be a strength. Meanwhile, Anna's return fractures Aimee and Wayne's alliance when she offers a different version of the past, leaving Aimee torn between loyalty to her dad and the mum she never stopped missing. Lewis's redemption arc implodes when his public apology tour exposes more chaos than growth, forcing Kieron to stage an intervention.

Donovan realises that his knowledge gives him leverage, and he offers the team a deal - he will tell them where the cab driver is in return for an immunity agreement. Ronnie and Sam have just ten hours to find the hostage before the CPS is forced to agree to Donovan's terms.
